integrity: Same-model symbolic proof reconstruction, two independent counting implementations on finite domains, and specified literature implication checks; no claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Optimizes the union of all subsequence lengths for binary words of Hamming weight three, not individual fixed-deletion spheres or other weights; priority is best-knowledge and an equivalent unindexed earlier theorem may exist.
title: Maximum scattered-subsequence complexity for binary words with three ones
